questions.cardText:
[Linguistics] What is “pidgin”?
A. A formal language used in Java
B. A tribal language in West Africa
C. A simplified language that develops between groups
Answer: C. Pidgin languages often arise in trade or contact zones where speakers of different native languages need to communicate for practical purposes.
questions.de: Wie nennt man eine grammatisch vereinfachte Kontaktsprache, die – oft für den Handel – zwischen Gruppen ohne gemeinsame Sprache entsteht?
questions.en: What is the term for a grammatically simplified contact language that develops, often for trade, between groups of people who have no language in common?

timeline.labelEn: The term “pidgin English” (“business English”) is first attested
timeline.labelDe: Der Ausdruck „pidgin English“ („Geschäftsenglisch“) ist erstmals belegt

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] Which of the major oceans is the saltiest ocean?
A. Atlantic Ocean
B. Indian Ocean
C. Pacific Ocean
Answer: A. The Atlantic Ocean’s high salinity is influenced by factors such as high evaporation rates, low precipitation, and minimal freshwater inflow in certain regions. This is also why oysters from the Atlantic taste saltier than those from other oceans.
questions.de: Welcher der großen Ozeane ist im Durchschnitt der salzigste?
questions.en: Which of the major oceans is, on average, the saltiest?

timeline.labelEn: Herodotus names the “Atlantic sea” (Sea of Atlas) in his Histories
timeline.labelDe: Herodot nennt in seinen Historien das „Atlantische Meer“ (Meer des Atlas)

questions.notes: The oyster claim on the card is unverified and not used. The most saline open sea is the Red Sea (not a major ocean).
